t: Sleek, curved electric shower features minimalist-style power control buttons, with separate temperature dial and standalone start/stop push button for easy operation. Phased shutdown flushes out hot water after showering, helping to prevent limescale build-up. Retains preferred power and temperature settings. Easy-clean, 5-spray pattern showerhead and 1.25m anti-twist hose.
b: Suitable for Cold Mains Water Only
